findings.message: The structure and vigraha for c1 attach virājamāna to the wave-vines ((…vallarī)-virājamāna)-mūrdhan, but the note presents virājamāna-mūrdhan ('a shining head') as an inner unit, which implies the other grouping.
findings.suggested_fix: Align the note with the structure, or say both groupings are possible.
